raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On HIP every per-image LFM2-VL request takes the per-request encoder path. A run at concurrency 32 admitted 771 requests over 188 prefill batches and ran the vision encoder 771 times. CUDA already batches per-image cache misses across requests. On HIP, the check that allows this batching excludes every model.

## Modifications

1. `python/sglang/srt/managers/mm_schedule.py`: the per-request fallback decision moves into `_use_per_request_encode_fallback`. NPU and XPU always take the fallback. HIP takes it unless the encoder's model is in `_HIP_CROSS_REQUEST_ENCODE_ARCHS`, which lists LFM2-VL. CUDA always batches, as on main.
2. `mm_schedule.py`: add `Lfm2VlForConditionalGeneration` to `_can_skip_pre_embed_feature_move`. On every platform the scheduler leaves LFM2-VL features where they are and the model uploads them in one copy.
3. `python/sglang/srt/models/lfm2_vl.py`: build the pixel tensor with `materialize_multimodal_features` (one destination buffer, per-item `copy_`) instead of per-item `.to()` plus `torch.cat`.
4. `test/registered/chunked_prefill/test_mm_chunked_embedding_unit.py` (CPU suite): sends two single-image requests through `_get_chunked_prefill_embedding` and checks that they take one encoder call on HIP for LFM2-VL, two on HIP for another model, and one on CUDA. The HIP LFM2-VL case fails on main.

## Accuracy Tests

HIP was not re-run for this revision. No AMD GPU was available. The MI325X numbers below are from the first revision of this branch (2026-08-05).

On MI325X (Torch 2.9.1 + ROCm 7.2, BF16), VLMEvalKit CountBenchQA scores 417/487 with zero inference or judge failures. The multi-resolution and 7,819-token long-image diagnostics against HF pass. The worst max delta is 0.2275 in prefill and 0.1360 in decode.

Items 2 and 3 also change the LFM2-VL feature upload on CUDA, so CUDA was checked too. `LiquidAI/LFM2-VL-3B`, 1x B300, BF16, TP=1, `temperature=0`. Branch head c259a49cb5 (with main d748bede96 merged in) is compared against main d748bede96.

```
python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path LiquidAI/LFM2-VL-3B --host 127.0.0.1 --port 31677 --attention-backend flashinfer --chunked-prefill-size 2048
```

| Check | main | this PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| One image, rendered "417" | `'417'` | `'417'` |
| Rendered 3-digit number, 1 image per prompt, 512-2048 px, 64 prompts | 64/64 | 64/64 |
| 3 images per prompt, correct per position, 64 prompts | 64 / 64 / 61 | 64 / 64 / 61 |
| 256 requests, 1-3 random-noise images, 256-1536 px, C=32 | 256 ok, 0 errors | 256 ok, 0 errors |
| Embedding-length mismatch warnings | 0 | 0 |

The test container ships flashinfer 0.7.1 and main pins 0.7.2, so both trees ran with `SGLANG_SKIP_SGL_KERNEL_VERSION_CHECK=1`.

Unit tests, CPU:

```
python3 -m pytest -q test/registered/chunked_prefill/test_mm_chunked_embedding_unit.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_mm_embedding_length.py test/registered/unit/managers/test_multimodal_abort_cleanup.py test/registered/unit/multimodal/test_feature_materialization.py test/registered/unit/models/test_kimi_k3_vision.py test/registered/unit/models/test_qwen3_vl_feature_materialization.py
```

| Tree | Passed | Failed |
|---|---:|---:|
| this PR | 87 | 0 |
| main d748bede96 | 84 | 0 |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MI325X BF16, one 512 px image per request, 268 input + 32 output tokens, 128 prompts per run, 1 warmup + 3 measured runs. These numbers are from the first revision of this branch (2026-08-05) and were not re-measured:

| Path | C=16 | C=32 |
|---|---:|---:|
| Per-request encoder | 1,320 ± 3.6 tok/s | 1,429 ± 86.9 tok/s |
| Cross-request encoder | 1,477 ± 9.5 tok/s | 1,665 ± 87.2 tok/s |
| Change | +11.9% | +16.5% |

± is the standard deviation over the 3 measured runs. A rerun on MI325X against this head is still needed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).
